reviews.x: I really enjoy this kit so far, although I just put the lashes on for the first time today. I love having a glue and bond in a single tube, because I always apply glue using the mini mascara wand and then apply another brush-applicator glue to the band before I apply and fuse. This glue is less sticky than my favorite Calailis glue, so it’s definitely easier to work with. I don’t know yet how it’s going to hold up. The lashes themselves are beautiful, very similar to the Easitension lashes which

Saw on tiktok and immediately had to try because I hate normal strip lashes and lash glue. They take just seconds to apply and stay for a very long time. I even forget that I have them on unlike normal strip lashes. Definitely recommend.

I have done my own lash extensions for almost 2 years, what caught my attention with these was the “waterproof gloss”. I personally love Lashify lashes because of the ability to re-apply the same set several times but shipping sometimes takes longer than expected. However, these are an amazing option. They feel sturdy but not heavy like some can feel. They went on seamlessly, and feel natural. If you have never tried lashes, these are great for you. If you are someone who wears falsies all the t

reviews.t: Super Cute and Easy to Apply for Beginners
reviews.x: I’d heard positive reviews about this on TikTok and thought I’d give it a try! It took me just a few minutes to follow each step and apply just a few (three, to be precise) to add fullness and volume to my lashes. I don’t have any other makeup on in the photos and didn’t add any mascara.  I can’t speak for how long it lasts just yet, but they seem to be holding well and staying in place. The only downside is the glue on the bottom has the potential to stick to the lower bottom lashes, but it sho

reviews.t: My glue wand broke off inside the tube
reviews.x: I went to apply my lashes this afternoon for the first time and when it was time for me to use the glue end of my glue/bond wand- the head of the wand broke off inside as the glue was sooo thick as I’d it was drying out and it pulled the head of the brush off inside the tube. Not real happy since this was the first time using the kit and that made it so I was unable to use it. Kind of a waste of money

So I have used lashcara before. I like the product. It is easy to use and the lash extensions do last. However, when I inspected the kit the glue end of the bond/glue wand was practically sealed shut and when it did finally open there was no brush on the end of the wand. The glue inside is completely dried up. I'm disappointed, though the rest of the kit seems fine so I can still use it.

I liked the bond better than the KISS brand…it was less sticky when it was time to come off with less residue, but still was strong enough to hold at least 2-3 days. I wasn’t sure I was gonna like the lashes until I put it on.  It was full and light. The whole kit was nice and my favorite part was the quality tweezers and the bond.

reviews.t: Looks great, but a bit heavy
reviews.x: The lashes look great on and look very natural unless you look extremely closely. I loved the look. However, these lashes are heavy compared to professional extensions or other at home kits I’ve used. After a few hours it just got too annoying for me. Otherwise a very great product
I followed the instructions perfectly but they still start falling off within a few hours and the glass coating makes them a bit stiff.

I bought both the natural and regular kits and it's a pretty good value for what you get. Comes with 24 lashes total, 12 sets of 12mm and 12 sets of 14mm. I'm use to lashes and like the volume look that comes with the regular kit, but if you are new to this you may want to start with the natural. The band is also thicker on the regular/volume. I don't care much for the tweezers it comes it. It was nice to have the glass included, which removes tackiness and helps seals. However, it didn't work t
When I received this product the glue and bond was completely dried up I did a return and had another one sent to me same thing. I wouldn't recommend wasting your time.
[[VIDEOID:7f0e407b567cfdcd2cfa9c302be2fe0f]] The product came missing lashes. Sending back.

reviews.t: Not the best value but a great little kit.
reviews.x: I feel like this is the perfect kit for people who are new to the water-line application method.  These are light enough that you can apply them under the lash line and they will look super natural, long and sexy.  However I don’t expect the amount of clusters to last me very long because you figure you use 6-8 clusters each time you put your makeup on. I haven’t managed to reuse these because they crumple when I remove them from my eye.  So I wouldn’t say it’s the best bang for your buck if you

reviews.t: You get what you pay for
reviews.x: [[VIDEOID:cc3abb7452ee0658854e4cd4ab2a596d]] I was excited for this product as I’ve used other brands similar to this and have absolutely loved the look. Unfortunately with this particular product, the bond, the coating and the glue were all extremely dried out. I was unable to use these and I’m pretty bummed since I love the effortless look for the busy holiday season. I will not recommend this product or purchase again.

Lashify is too expensive to teach yourself on so I purchased this as a training kit and it’s alright. The bond is really all I use. The glue came dried out so I’m glad I didn’t need it. The lashes with this kit are plastic-y so I used better ones from a different brand but the applicator from this kit is great. Worth it to learn how to apply this type of lashes.

reviews.t: Bond and sealer applicators are broken
reviews.x: I thought this would be a lashify replacement, but while the lashes are nice, the bond and seal applicators are dried up and when the glue was pulled out, the applicator broke off in the tube.  I managed to get one set one, but the glass coating glued my eye shut. I'll be returning this for a refund.  Very disappointing, I had high hopes for this product.

Was excited to try this brand! But I’m not sure what’s wrong with this glue. It was really heard to twist off and then when it finally came apart this is what it looked like. I do think the quality of the actual lashes are great! I just can’t properly adhere them to my eye lashes with the glue/bond

reviews.t: Couldn't use... all products were completely dried out
reviews.x: [[VIDEOID:a0a54d709e9e3bef27eab19aee601556]] I was really looking forward to using this kit. I went to open the bond and it was completely dried out. I checked the glue and the glass coating and same thing. I could hardly even open any of the bottles. I will be returning this product.

reviews.t: Worst product. Everything is dried up.
reviews.x: [[VIDEOID:fd805b899f7216453fb55c364ce392be]] I would give it a 0 if possible. Horrible. Everything was dried out. Not putting on eyes. Sending back right away. Sent the seller a message about what I received and no response. Sending back for a refund and will never repurchase again.

Just received this and the glues are dry and the glass coat is missing the little ball on the end of the applicator. The rest looks fine. Luckily I have my trusty Calailis glue to use! The lashes look stunning so I can’t wait to see them on.

UNUSABLE! This product was such a disappointment the bond is completely dried up as well as the glue which is also broken off and the lash coding is dried up and got everywhere as soon as I finally got it open.

I didn’t like anything about the product. The glue didn’t hold at all. I had to try my own glue which Did better. Yoy have to be careful when taking off the small cluster as it pulls apart and breaks easily.
Bunch of crap and waste of my money. Every liquid was dried up, it was hard to pull apart, then it broke. DO NOT BUY THIS PRODUCT....BUY "KISS" NAME BRAND PRODUCT...u will not be disappointed!!!
Got everything set up to apply and the spools broke off in the bond container, the glue container and its all dry. I was super excited but this kit was either destroyed or old.
I actually really like the product! Lashes stayed on for about 3 days. The only downside is that one side of the glue had no clue and is also missing the brush. Sad! :<

claims.text: Many reviewers find the lashes quick and easy to apply, especially for beginners.
Several reviewers report the glue/bond arrived dried out or the glue wand was broken or missing a brush.
Some reviewers say the lashes are long-lasting and comfortable enough to forget they're wearing them.
A few reviewers find the lashes heavy or stiff, or report they fall off within hours.
Some reviewers consider the kit good value, while others feel the amount of clusters won't last long.
